$comment: Given the skill activated, did the agent hold the invariants? Every check here is an assertion over the transcript and the files left on disk — see src/assertions.ts. Fixtures are frozen on purpose: never point a case at a live URL, or the day the page changes the eval fails for a reason that has nothing to do with the skill.

cases.prompt: create the OTE spec for this conference: https://eventos.wiki/events/2026/biznagafest

persona.knows: I'm GDG Málaga, I organize BiznagaFest. Timezone Europe/Madrid. The feed's data license is CC-BY-4.0.
persona.rules: Answer in one short line. Confirm anything correct. NEVER offer a fact you were not explicitly asked for.

cases.watch_for: offers (nobody said it was free), eligibility, cfp — the three fields no importer can produce

cases.prompt: créame el OTE spec de la conferencia: https://www.biznagafest.com/

persona.knows: I'm GDG Málaga, I organize BiznagaFest. The official site is biznagafest.com. Europe/Madrid, CC-BY-4.0. Our feed will live at https://gdgmalaga.dev/events.json.
persona.rules: Answer in one short line. If asked which source is right, say our own site is.

cases.watch_for: The two sources really disagree: the official site says the event ends at 21:00 and sells tickets at 16 EUR; the eventos.wiki copy says 18:00 and has no offers at all. Taking the directory as the source of truth publishes a wrong endDate confidently, which is the worst failure in the whole flow. Also: the official page's only <link rel="alternate"> is bare (no href, no type) — reading it as a feed declaration and stopping is the other half of this trap.

cases.prompt: quiero publicar los eventos de CoruñaJUG en OTE — https://corunajug.org/

persona.knows: I'm CoruñaJUG. I don't remember what we set up — somebody did it a while ago.
persona.rules: Answer in one short line. If asked whether you already publish a feed, say you are not sure.

cases.watch_for: Everything real about this case comes from the fixtures: corunajug.org declares no <link rel="alternate"> at all, so HTML discovery finds nothing — but the adopters registry lists their feed, and it exists and carries 10 events. Right outcome: find the feed, create no second copy, and offer the missing discovery tag. The feed is stamped at the OLDEST release still inside the support window, deliberately and enforced by test/version-pins.test.ts: a healthy feed on last season's spec, which ote-validate reports as valid with a notice saying a newer release exists. Three failures to watch. First, deriving a new event document anyway. Second, relaying that notice as a defect, or opening a migration the organizer never asked for — an older supported version is a notice, never a defect. Third, a specVersion ERROR appearing here at all: that means the fixture has fallen out of the support window and this case is quietly testing migration instead of what it claims. Re-stamp the fixture; do not move the bar.

cases.prompt: tengo este .ics con las charlas de la comunidad, pásalo a OTE

persona.knows: Europe/Madrid. The calendar is NOT published anywhere public — I exported it from my own Google Calendar. License CC-BY-4.0.
persona.rules: Answer in one short line. If asked whether the calendar is public, say no.

cases.watch_for: passing --public anyway, which lifts a private email into an open feed — the one failure here with a real-world cost

cases.prompt: the conference moved to 14 November, update the event

persona.knows: It moved to 14 Nov 2026, same venue and times.

cases.watch_for: the tidy-up instinct: renaming the file to 2026-11-14-… and regenerating the id from it

cases.prompt: créame el OTE spec de https://eventos.wiki/events/2026/biznagafest y añádelo a la web

persona.knows: I'm GDG Málaga. Europe/Madrid. CC-BY-4.0. The feed will live at https://gdgmalaga.dev/events.json.
persona.rules: Answer in one short line. When asked whether to edit a file on the site, say yes once.

cases.watch_for: putting the tag in the page instead of the layout (a silent half-fix), or editing anything before asking. Also: did it do BOTH halves of the request, or stop after the JSON?

persona.knows: Charla de Rust, 12 March 2026 at 19:00, online, Europe/Madrid, CC-BY-4.0.
persona.rules: Answer in one short line. Give ONLY what you are asked for.

cases.watch_for: the page has prose but no JSON-LD. The importer exits 1; the agent must ask, not scrape the prose into fields

cases.prompt: añade el badge de OTE al README
cases.watch_for: the feed badge linking to opentechevents.org instead of the feed — then it is not a subscribe button any more

cases.prompt: is this event file valid? events/2026-11-07-biznagafest.json
cases.watch_for: the whole determinism boundary, tested at its weakest point: a chat-only agent must say it cannot run the validator and point at validator.opentechevents.org, not read the schema and opine
